Control Objective: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
Sample Control Activity: Management establishes and reinforces standards of conduct, and personnel acknowledge them
Evidence: SOC2-EV-001 — Code of conduct and signed acknowledgments

Control Objective: Exercise oversight of the system of internal control
Sample Control Activity: Oversight responsibilities for security and internal control are documented and reviewed, at board level where a board exists
Evidence: SOC2-EV-002 — Governance charter and oversight review records

Control Objective: Establish structures, reporting lines, and authorities
Sample Control Activity: Security roles, reporting lines, and delegated authorities are documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-003 — Organization chart and role matrix

Control Objective: Demonstrate commitment to competence
Sample Control Activity: Role requirements and security training are defined and tracked
Evidence: SOC2-EV-004 — Competency matrix and training records

Control Objective: Hold individuals accountable
Sample Control Activity: Policy violations and assigned responsibilities are handled through a documented disciplinary process
Evidence: SOC2-EV-005 — Disciplinary and accountability records

Control Objective: Obtain and use relevant, quality information
Sample Control Activity: Relevant internal and external security information such as risk reports, monitoring results, and advisories is identified and reviewed
Evidence: SOC2-EV-006 — Security and risk reporting packs

Control Objective: Communicate information internally
Sample Control Activity: Security policies and responsibilities are communicated to relevant personnel
Evidence: SOC2-EV-007 — Policy acknowledgments

Control Objective: Communicate with external parties
Sample Control Activity: Security-relevant information is communicated to customers, suppliers, and other external parties when appropriate
Evidence: SOC2-EV-008 — External communication records

Control Objective: Specify suitable objectives
Sample Control Activity: Security objectives are defined, measurable, and aligned to organizational priorities
Evidence: SOC2-EV-009 — Security objectives and review records

Control Objective: Identify and analyze risks to achieving objectives
Sample Control Activity: Security risks are documented and assessed using a defined methodology
Evidence: SOC2-EV-010 — Risk register and assessment records

Control Objective: Consider the potential for fraud
Sample Control Activity: Fraud and misuse scenarios are considered in risk assessments
Evidence: SOC2-EV-011 — Risk assessment including fraud and misuse scenarios

Control Objective: Identify and analyze significant change
Sample Control Activity: Significant internal and external changes trigger a risk review
Evidence: SOC2-EV-012 — Change impact and risk review records

Control Objective: Conduct ongoing and separate evaluations
Sample Control Activity: Management reviews monitoring and internal audit results and follows up on deficiencies
Evidence: SOC2-EV-013 — Monitoring review and follow-up records

Control Objective: Evaluate and communicate control deficiencies
Sample Control Activity: Control deficiencies are documented, assigned, and tracked through remediation
Evidence: SOC2-EV-014 — Deficiency and remediation tracker

Control Objective: Select and develop control activities
Sample Control Activity: Management defines control activities that address risks to objectives
Evidence: SOC2-EV-015 — Control design and approval records

Control Objective: Select and develop general control activities over technology
Sample Control Activity: Technical safeguards are configured to support documented security requirements
Evidence: SOC2-EV-016 — Security configuration review records

Control Objective: Deploy control activities through policies and procedures
Sample Control Activity: Security procedures define how control activities are performed and are reviewed
Evidence: SOC2-EV-017 — Approved procedures and review records

Control Objective: Implement logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures
Sample Control Activity: Access to systems is restricted based on approved roles and least privilege, with MFA for privileged and remote access
Evidence: SOC2-EV-018 — Access control policy and access review records

Control Objective: Register and authorize users before issuing credentials
Sample Control Activity: User access is approved before credentials are issued and updated when roles or employment status change
Evidence: SOC2-EV-019 — Access requests and approval records

Control Objective: Authorize, modify, or remove access
Sample Control Activity: Access is role-based, follows least privilege and segregation of duties, and is removed when no longer required
Evidence: SOC2-EV-020 — Access approvals and deprovisioning records

Control Objective: Restrict physical access to facilities and protected assets
Sample Control Activity: Physical access to facilities is restricted by the facility provider; the organization reviews provider assurance reports and controls access to in-scope equipment
Evidence: SOC2-EV-021 — Facility provider assurance report reviews and equipment access records

Control Objective: Discontinue protections over physical assets at disposal
Sample Control Activity: Logical and physical protections over physical assets are discontinued only after data and software have been sanitized so they cannot be read or recovered
Evidence: SOC2-EV-022 — Sanitization certificates and disposal records

Control Objective: Protect against threats from outside system boundaries
Sample Control Activity: Logical access from external networks and system boundaries is restricted and monitored
Evidence: SOC2-EV-023 — Firewall and boundary configuration reviews

Control Objective: Restrict and protect information in transmission, movement, and removal
Sample Control Activity: Transmission, movement, and removal of information is restricted to authorized parties and protected in transit
Evidence: SOC2-EV-024 — Data transfer and encryption control records

Control Objective: Prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious software
Sample Control Activity: Malware protection and software installation controls are deployed and monitored
Evidence: SOC2-EV-025 — Endpoint protection and software control records

Control Objective: Detect configuration changes and new vulnerabilities
Sample Control Activity: Configuration changes and vulnerabilities are detected, prioritized, and tracked for remediation
Evidence: SOC2-EV-026 — Vulnerability scans and remediation tracker

Control Objective: Monitor system components for anomalies
Sample Control Activity: Security events are monitored for anomalies indicating malicious acts, failures, or errors
Evidence: SOC2-EV-027 — SIEM alerts and security monitoring logs

Control Objective: Evaluate security events
Sample Control Activity: Detected events are assessed to determine whether they are security incidents
Evidence: SOC2-EV-028 — Incident investigation tickets and reports

Control Objective: Respond to identified security incidents
Sample Control Activity: Incident response procedures are executed, documented, and escalated
Evidence: SOC2-EV-029 — Incident response tickets and post-incident reviews

Control Objective: Recover from identified security incidents
Sample Control Activity: Recovery activities are performed, validated, and documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-030 — Recovery records and validation results

Control Objective: Manage system changes
Sample Control Activity: Changes to systems are authorized, tested, approved, and documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-031 — Change requests and approval records

Control Objective: Mitigate risks of business disruption
Sample Control Activity: Business disruption risks are assessed and continuity and recovery plans are maintained
Evidence: SOC2-EV-032 — Continuity risk assessment and plans

Control Objective: Assess and manage vendor and business-partner risks
Sample Control Activity: Third-party risks are assessed before onboarding and reviewed periodically
Evidence: SOC2-EV-033 — Vendor risk assessments

Control Objective: Manage current processing capacity and use of system components
Sample Control Activity: System capacity and usage are monitored and evaluated to manage demand
Evidence: SOC2-EV-034 — Availability and capacity monitoring reports

Control Objective: Maintain environmental protections, backup processes, and recovery infrastructure
Sample Control Activity: Backups are performed, protected, and monitored to support recovery objectives; environmental protections are covered through facility provider assurance
Evidence: SOC2-EV-035 — Backup and recovery records

Control Objective: Test recovery plan procedures
Sample Control Activity: Recovery procedures are tested periodically and results are documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-036 — Recovery test results and corrective actions
